# 1. Configuration
```{r config}
# Output directories
fastqc_reports_dir <- "01_quality_control/fastqc_reports"
multiqc_output_dir <- "01_quality_control/multiqc_report"

cat("FastQC reports directory:", fastqc_reports_dir, "\n")
cat("MultiQC output directory:", multiqc_output_dir, "\n")
```

# 2. Verify FastQC Reports

**Note:** FastQC was run manually from PowerShell due to compatibility issues with R on Windows.

**Command used:**
```bash
cd C:\Users\10935\Documents\FastQC
.\run_fastqc.bat -t 4 C:\Users\10935\Documents\Proyecto_Adenocarcinoma_RNAseq\00_raw_data\fastq\*.fastq.gz
```

```{r verify-fastqc}
# Check HTML reports
html_files <- list.files(fastqc_reports_dir, pattern = "_fastqc\\.html$")

# Check ZIP reports (required by MultiQC)
zip_files <- list.files(fastqc_reports_dir, pattern = "_fastqc\\.zip$")

cat("HTML reports:", length(html_files), "\n")
cat("ZIP reports: ", length(zip_files), "\n")

if (length(html_files) == 40 && length(zip_files) == 40) {
  cat("All reports present (40 samples x 2 reads)\n")
} else {
  cat("Missing reports — check FastQC execution\n")
}
```

# 3. Run MultiQC

**To run:** change `eval=FALSE` to `eval=TRUE`.
```{r run-multiqc, eval=FALSE}
cat("Running MultiQC...\n")
cat("Start:", format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"), "\n\n")

# Create output directory
dir.create(multiqc_output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Absolute paths (required on Windows)
reports_abs <- normalizePath(fastqc_reports_dir, winslash = "/")
output_abs  <- normalizePath(multiqc_output_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)

# Build MultiQC command
multiqc_cmd <- sprintf(
  'multiqc "%s" -o "%s" -n QC_Report --force',
  reports_abs,
  output_abs
)

system(multiqc_cmd)

cat("\nMultiQC complete\n")
cat("End:", format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"), "\n")
```

# 4. Verify MultiQC Report
```{r verify-multiqc}
multiqc_report <- file.path(multiqc_output_dir, "QC_Report.html")

cat("MultiQC report:", ifelse(file.exists(multiqc_report), "OK", "Pending"), "\n")

if (file.exists(multiqc_report)) {
  cat("\nOpen report at:\n")
  cat(normalizePath(multiqc_report), "\n")
}
```

# 5. Quality Criteria Interpretation
```{r interpretation}
cat("QUALITY CONTROL CRITERIA\n\n")

cat("GOOD QUALITY:\n")
cat("  - Phred score > 28 across most positions\n")
cat("  - Stable GC content (~40-60%)\n")
cat("  - No overrepresented sequences\n")
cat("  - No adapter contamination\n\n")

cat("TRIMMING REQUIRED IF:\n")
cat("  - Quality drops below 20 at read ends\n")
cat("  - Adapter sequences detected\n")
cat("  - Irregular GC content\n")
```
